result.brief: MacJEPA 将 JEPA 掩码从自监督预训练目标改造为监督鲁棒性目标，对齐掩码与干净的多模态内容 token 及任务查询潜表征，实现未裁剪自我中心视频中时间局部模态缺失下的音视频识别。
result.reason: Repurposes JEPA masking into a supervised robustness objective aligning masked/clean latents for audio-visual tokens and queries, a representation-learning contribution on untrimmed video.
